summary: Roles are documented by adding a role argument spec in meta/argument_specs.yml, with an example from the telekom_mms.icinga_director collection.
questions: How do I write documentation for a role in my collection?
Which file holds a role's argument spec?

answer_card.title: Documenting roles
answer_card.answer_md: Add a role argument spec at `meta/argument_specs.yml` in the role. See the role argument spec docs; the `telekom_mms.icinga_director.ansible_icinga` role is a good example.
